title: East coast to the onsen, walkable
caption: The third south-half district from island-half-1: the dorm row, the dorms' sea terrace, the east coast walk and the onsen path up to the onsen's front. Reach it from the east lane in the morning: turn east off the dorm street into the dorm row. It also loads with ?place=east_coast. The onsen is shut for now.

sections.title: The dorm row
sections.caption: Before: backdrop only, seen from the east lane. After: Eric walks east along the row from the dorm street toward the terrace. The camera looks along the row from a little north of it and steeply, so the row's trees don't hide him.

sections.title: The sea terrace
sections.caption: Before: the terrace was closed on every side and the sea had no wall. After: the terrace opens on its east side onto the coast walk, a finger sign points the way (Onsen 温泉), and the coast has its sea wall, rocks and surf.

sections.title: The east coast walk
sections.caption: Before: lawn and trees behind dorm_4, the sea flat. After: the walk north along the coast, lamps on its landward edge, benches in two bays looking over it to the sea, pines along the wall. The camera looks north-east, the sea on the right.

sections.title: The onsen
sections.caption: Before: nothing there. After: past the tennis courts and through the trees to the red gate in the onsen's white wall, おんせん on a tall board beside it. Inside, a stone walk between raked gravel to the porch; the doors are shut with a 準備中 CLOSED card. Nothing behind them is built.

sections.title: More
sections.caption: At the onsen's door, and the onsen after work, its lanterns and paper screens lit.
